label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: Auction homes caught in court
stories.story: Matthias Magoola’s lawyers warn buyers off properties Equity Bank has advertised. The loans, Shs82 billion and $43 million, are still disputed in court.
stories.you: Selling a bank-auction property? Check for court cases before your client pays a deposit.

stories.title: Evicting without a court order
stories.story: Two men were remanded in Kira, charged on six counts including evicting occupants of land in Kitukutwe without a court order.
stories.you: Plot with people on it? Don’t promise vacant possession until they have left legally.

stories.title: NSSF to sell 350 Temangalo homes
stories.story: Bookings for the first 350 houses at Temangalo, Wakiso, are expected to open at the end of November. Handover is 31 March 2027.
stories.you: Buyers will compare. Sell what NSSF can’t: homes that are ready to move into now.

stories.title: 3 in 4 buildings fail standards
stories.story: The building review board told MPs it inspected 11,492 developments in a year. Only a quarter met the standards.
stories.you: Ask owners for approved plans before you list. Buyers and banks will check.
stories.source: Source: The Independent, via allAfrica · 9 Nov 2026

stories.title: Power gaps are being mapped
stories.story: A Shs10.5 billion, 18-month survey will map areas short of power. Some schools and clinics are 20–40 km from the grid.
stories.you: Power sells plots. Tell buyers how far the nearest line is — put it in your advert.
